description: The first Phase 2 PRD: a THIN end-to-end vertical slice that proves the live chat loop works inside the v2 Astryx shell — select a thread -> its live transcript streams into the content well -> type in a minimal composer -> send -> reply streams back. Deliberately minimal (plain text, no tool cards / spine / rich composer pickers — those are p2b/p2c). The GOAL is to de-risk the data/WS integration in the new shell before fanning out. Reuses v1's existing useAgentChat + /ws/agent + /api/agent/* via a NEW ui/src/v2/lib adapter; the gateway and v1 are UNCHANGED. READ docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md (esp. §9 Phase-2 roadmap) BEFORE any story.

designFile.contentWellNode: 4N-0 (#262626, 24px top-left corner) — the transcript + composer live inside this well
designFile.note: RJ-0 draws the well EMPTY ('Transcript and composer land in a later phase') — there is NO pixel design for the transcript/composer yet. For this skeleton, build FUNCTION first and style to ui/src/v2/tokens.css; the rich visual design of the transcript (p2b) and composer (p2c) needs its own Paper frame (flagged as a dependency in docs §9). v1's ChatPane.tsx is the BEHAVIOR reference (what a turn does), not a style target for v2.

conventions.reuseHooks: v2 REUSES v1's data layer — import useAgentChat (ui/src/hooks/useAgentChat.ts) and the /api/agent/* fetches through a NEW adapter under ui/src/v2/lib/. Do NOT modify src/ (the gateway), useAgentChat, or any v1 component — only import them. The hook is presentation-agnostic (returns items + send); v2 renders those items with Astryx.
conventions.astryxOnly: v2 components use @astryxdesign/core only (Chat category has messaging UI — `npx astryx search chat`). No shadcn/Radix, no Tailwind classes, no raw <div> layout, no hardcoded hex/px — component props + ui/src/v2/tokens.css tokens only. Per ui/.claude/CLAUDE.md, discover components via `npx astryx build "<idea>"` / `astryx component <Name>` before writing UI.
conventions.scopeDiscipline: This is a WALKING SKELETON. Plain streamed text + a Working indicator only. NO tool cards, plan cards, approval UI, activity spine, provider/model/effort picker, pins, context meter, or work-log rollups — every one of those is explicitly out of scope here and belongs to p2b/p2c. Keep the surface tiny so the integration is the only variable.
conventions.v1Untouched: v1 renders pixel-unchanged with the flag OFF. Astryx CSS stays dynamic-imported in the v2 entry.
conventions.liveVerification: A real turn needs a running gateway + an installed/authed provider. Verify on a THROWAWAY stack, NEVER a human's :3747/:5173: `CONAN_PORT=3799 CONAN_DATA_DIR=/tmp/conan-v2-qa npm start` + `VITE_CONAN_V2=1 CONAN_PORT=3799 CONAN_UI_PORT=5199 npm run dev` + `CONAN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5199`, driven with automate-browser. If NO provider is installed/authed on the machine, fall back to asserting the pipeline: the send frame is emitted on /ws/agent and a returned message renders as an assistant item (stub the reply) — and say so honestly in progress.txt.
conventions.gatewayRule: Never run a human's :3747 gateway or :5173 Vite from an agent session (dies on teardown). Throwaway ports only; kill by port when done.

userStories.title: v2 chat data adapter + active-thread wiring (foundation)
userStories.description: As the team, we need a clean seam between the v2 Astryx UI and v1's existing chat data layer, plus an 'active thread' concept, so the content well can host a live session for whatever the sidebar selects.
acceptanceCriteria: New ui/src/v2/lib/useV2Chat.ts — a thin adapter that wraps the existing useAgentChat (ui/src/hooks/useAgentChat.ts) and exposes exactly what v2 needs: { items, send, status, busy }. Do NOT reimplement the socket; import and delegate. Do NOT modify useAgentChat or src/.

App.v2.tsx gains an activeThread state (a { cwd, projectId, provider } descriptor, provider defaulting to 'claude'); selecting a sidebar thread sets it. For the skeleton, wiring the REAL project list is out of scope — a placeholder selection that yields a valid cwd (e.g. the current repo root from the existing /api/config or a fixture) is enough to open a live session.

ProjectTree/ThreadRow onSelect is wired to set activeThread (these are the sidebar's own components; App.v2 owns the state + passes a callback down — this is a composition change, allowed here since p2a owns App.v2.tsx/Sidebar.tsx for the wiring seam).

The content well renders a new ui/src/v2/chat/V2ChatView.tsx built on Astryx ChatLayout (import from '@astryxdesign/core/Chat') — it docks the composer to the bottom with the frosted blur and gives auto-scroll + jump-to-present for free; empty transcript is fine this story
Astryx-only, tokens-only; v1 untouched; typecheck passes; cd ui && npm run build passes; the existing v2 Vitest suite still passes
userStories.notes: Foundation / hard barrier for p2a. Reuse v1's useAgentChat — read its return shape first (items, send, status, busy, contextTokens). Astryx: VStack https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/VStack (confirm via `npx astryx component <Name> --props --json`). Read docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md §9. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: Streaming transcript (text only) in the content well
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my prompt and the agent's streamed reply in the content well, so the well is a live conversation, not a placeholder.
acceptanceCriteria: New ui/src/v2/chat/V2Transcript.tsx renders useV2Chat().items inside Astryx ChatMessageList using ChatMessage (sender=user|assistant) + ChatMessageBubble, with the body in ChatTokenizedText (all from '@astryxdesign/core/Chat'); assistant text deltas append live, plus an honest 'Working…' state while busy with no assistant text yet
Text-only: a tool/plan/approval item renders as a minimal one-line 'ran a tool' placeholder (NOT a rich card) — rich rendering is p2b
Auto-scroll + jump-to-present come from ChatLayout/ChatMessageList — don't re-implement them; markdown may render as plain text for now (rich markdown is p2b)
Prefer Astryx's Chat-category messaging components (`npx astryx search chat`) for message rows; style via tokens only
Owns only ui/src/v2/chat/V2Transcript.tsx (+ its test); typecheck + build + vitest pass; v1 untouched
userStories.notes: Depends on US-201. Use Astryx ChatMessage (https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatMessage, import {ChatMessage} from '@astryxdesign/core/Chat') for message rows — confirm props with `npx astryx component ChatMessage --json`. Tool/plan/approval items get a MINIMAL one-line placeholder here; the rich ChatToolCalls (https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatToolCalls) is p2b. v1 ChatPane.tsx is the streaming behavior reference. Read docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md §9-10. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: Minimal composer — send a prompt
userStories.description: As a user, I want a simple input at the foot of the well where I type a message and send it, so I can drive a turn.
acceptanceCriteria: New ui/src/v2/chat/V2Composer.tsx built on Astryx ChatComposer with ChatComposerInput in the input slot and ChatSendButton in sendActions (all from '@astryxdesign/core/Chat'): controlled value/onChange, placeholder 'Ask anything', onSubmit -> send; ChatSendButton auto-toggles send/stop on stream. Do NOT hand-roll a textarea or send button
onSubmit calls useV2Chat().send(value, { cwd, provider }) using the active thread's cwd/provider (NO model/effort/permission pickers and NO ChatComposerDrawer/pins here — those are p2c)
Auto-grows to content within a sane max (mirror v1's composer behavior); token-styled only
Owns only ui/src/v2/chat/V2Composer.tsx (+ its test); typecheck + build + vitest pass; v1 untouched
userStories.notes: Depends on US-201; parallel with US-202 (separate files). Use Astryx ChatComposer (https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatComposer, import {ChatComposer} from '@astryxdesign/core/Chat') — it already gives input+send+stop+slots; confirm props with `npx astryx component ChatComposer --json`. The ChatComposerDrawer (https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatComposerDrawer) attachments/pins drawer and the provider/model/effort pickers are p2c. send signature: send(text, { cwd, provider, model?, effort?, projectId? }). Read docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md §9-10. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: End-to-end turn — assemble + verify the loop live
userStories.description: As the team, we need the transcript + composer assembled into V2ChatView and a real turn proven to round-trip inside the v2 shell, so the walking skeleton is validated before we fan out.
acceptanceCriteria: V2ChatView.tsx composes V2Transcript (fills the well) + V2Composer (pinned at its foot) for the active thread, using one useV2Chat instance

END-TO-END: with the flag ON, selecting a thread and sending a prompt streams a real reply into the transcript — verified on a THROWAWAY stack (see conventions.liveVerification) with automate-browser: screenshot the sent prompt + the streaming/settled reply; report console clean

If no provider is installed/authed on the machine, fall back to the stubbed-pipeline assertion (send frame on /ws/agent + assistant item renders) and state that explicitly in progress.txt — do NOT claim a live turn that didn't happen
No console errors during a turn; v1 untouched; typecheck + build + full vitest suite pass
Update docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md §9 with the p2a outcome (what streamed, any integration gotchas — e.g. dedupe/StyleX/WS quirks) so p2b/p2c start informed
userStories.notes: Integration/proof story — runs after US-202 + US-203. This is THE de-risking checkpoint: if the live loop doesn't work cleanly in the Astryx shell, STOP and write findings to progress.txt rather than papering over it. Read docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md §9. Suggested skills: automate-browser, audit-ui.

astryxChatComponents.import: All from '@astryxdesign/core/Chat'. Confirm props with `npx astryx component <Name> --json`. The full Chat category (15 components) covers our entire transcript+composer — COMPOSE these, don't hand-roll.
astryxChatComponents.ChatLayout: [p2a] Full-page chat shell: messages in flow + composer docked to bottom with frosted-glass blur, built-in auto-scroll + scroll-to-bottom. Wrap ChatMessageList + ChatComposer. https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatLayout
astryxChatComponents.ChatLayoutScrollButton: [p2a-free] Floating jump-to-present button; ChatLayout renders it by default (scrollButton prop to override). https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatLayoutScrollButton
astryxChatComponents.ChatMessageList: [p2a] Transcript container: role=log, aria-live=polite, infinite scroll, bottom-anchored. https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatMessageList
astryxChatComponents.ChatMessageBubble: [p2a] Bubble container (auto-styles by sender; filled/ghost; group prop). https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatMessageBubble
astryxChatComponents.ChatTokenizedText: [p2a] Message body — renders text, turning @mentions/#tags//commands into inline Badges; safe to use unconditionally. https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatTokenizedText
astryxChatComponents.ChatComposer: [p2a] Composer shell: onSubmit, value/onChange, placeholder, isDisabled, slots drawer/header/input/footer/sendActions. https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatComposer
astryxChatComponents.ChatComposerInput: [p2a] Rich input for the composer's input slot: @// typeahead (our autocomplete), inline token badges, ArrowUp/Down history, paste/drop files, iOS zoom floor. https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatComposerInput
astryxChatComponents.ChatSendButton: [p2a] Circular send/stop toggle; place inside ChatComposer, reads context (send->stop on stream) with no wiring. https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatSendButton
astryxChatComponents.ChatComposerTokenElement: [p2c] A single token chip outside the input (pin chips / @-refs). https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatComposerTokenElement
astryxChatComponents.ChatComposerDrawer: [p2c] Collapsible attachments/context-chips drawer for the composer's drawer slot (count/label). https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatComposerDrawer
astryxChatComponents.ChatDictationButton: [p2c/opt] Voice dictation toggle for the sendActions slot (pairs with useChatDictation). https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ChatDictationButton
